records.name: Urash
records.thought: My belly is full and the rain is steady, and what I want is not food but someone to stand beside. Balum asked me to the edge of the world, and I told him I would come, so my word binds me; he was last seen south, near Balul and Kragul, so I will go that way and meet them rather than wander alone. I will gather a few shells on the way if the path allows, but I will not linger where Skarek, a stranger I cannot yet read, stands.
records.feeling: A wary wish to belong, and some hope, toward Balum.

records.text: A blight struck the reedbulb: about half of them withered overnight.

records.name: Druuk
records.thought: My belly is empty and the plan I hold would march me to the mist while I starve; glory means nothing if I die on the way. Goldgrass is one step north and I will eat it now, then fill my arms with more before I go. Hrokek's three food tempts me, but he is strong and I am weak, so I take what the ground gives and watch him.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and greedy impatience, wary of Hrokek's strength.

records.name: Taren
records.text: Arlon, stay by Taren's Fire a while. The ridgecat prowls south, and two together are safer than one. I mean to raise a roof here, and I would have you under it.

records.name: Taren
records.thought: The ridgecat sits four steps south and I will not give it my back for long, but Arlon is right beside me and warm toward me, and Arli's hall draws people north while I have nothing but a fire. Strong strangers follow whoever feeds and shelters them, so I will put my wood and stone into something with my name on it. I'll taste the grain and hazel for my curiosity, and stay close to Arlon, since he is the one I think of when I think of a child.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward Arli's rising hall, warmth toward Arlon, and wary dread of the ridgecat.

say.text: Arlon, stay by Taren's Fire a while. The ridgecat prowls south, and two together are safer than one. I mean to raise a roof here, and I would have you under it.

records.text: A stalker brought down a hopper.
Sekel built a shelter.

records.name: Hrokek
records.text: Druuk, take this. Eat. I am Hrokek, and I will not let you fall.

records.name: Hrokek
records.thought: Druuk is starving right beside me, and I carry three berries. Giving food would be the first gift of my life, and it would put someone in my debt. That is how allies are made, and I need allies. A starving man saved by me might follow me, and I badly want a place among others.
records.feeling: Eager to be needed, and drawn toward Druuk, who is starving.

say.text: Druuk, take this. Eat. I am Hrokek, and I will not let you fall.

changes: set its aim: "Find a band to belong to, and win the trust of those I help."
now wonders: What do berries taste like, and will Druuk stand with me if I save him?

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: zobitter (from bitterleaf).

records.name: Arlon
records.text: Taren, your fire gave me warmth and kept its word. I would stand beside you, and I would have a child with you if you are willing. I am Arlon, and I choose your fire.

records.name: Arlon
records.thought: Taren is one step away, and she kept her word about a place at her fire; I trust her more than anyone here, and I want a child with her and a fire that is mine too. I am fed and my energy is 89, so mating costs me little, and I will not hide what I want. The stalker north and the ridgecat southwest frighten me, so I will stay near Taren and the fires and not wander toward either. Grain and highbloom still call to me, but the grain is three steps east, away from the cats, so I will gather one and taste it while she is near.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Taren, with curiosity about grain and wariness of the cats.

say.text: Taren, your fire gave me warmth and kept its word. I would stand beside you, and I would have a child with you if you are willing. I am Arlon, and I choose your fire.

records.text: Arlon is courting Taren.
Skarek named a place "Skarek's Bank".

records.name: Skarek
records.thought: My belly is full and I feel the ache of having nothing that is mine. Ore, iron and coal lie right here, and a hand that takes what it needs should start by winning something from this ground. I want to be a healer whose name is sung, so I will learn what the plants here do, and I will taste the redcap underfoot first and see what it gives me.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with no one yet to follow me.
changes: set its aim: "Become a great healer: learn the plants of this land, gather wood and stone, and build a place that bears my name."
now wonders: What do redcap and reedbulb do to a body, and which plants could mend a wound?

records.name: Tlachi
records.text: Hotli, I come to pay what I owe. Take this flint from me. Kichi is sick, so keep clear of him as I will.

records.name: Tlachi
records.thought: My belly is full and my hands hold twelve flints, and still I have given Hotli nothing but words, while he gave first and asked for nothing. I will not leave that debt unpaid, because my word is good and I despise liars, so I will walk to him and put flint in his hands. Kichi is sick and sickness passes to those who stay close, so I will keep my distance from him, careful as I am, and afterward I will taste gorsemint and hazel to answer what gnaws at me.
records.feeling: Grateful and bound by a debt to Hotli, and curious about the foods I have not tasted.

say.text: Hotli, I come to pay what I owe. Take this flint from me. Kichi is sick, so keep clear of him as I will.

records.name: Quini
records.text: Kichi, I saw sunleaf ease you. I am bringing more for your sickness. Stay and rest.

records.name: Quini
records.thought: Kichi is sick and I have sunleaf seeds, and I watched sunleaf ease his wounds and his sickness. I cannot ease his sickness without a healing plant in hand, so I will gather sunleaf and bring it to him. That is a kindness, and it also shows whether he feeds those who stand by him. I am hungry too, so I will eat mudroot on the way, then follow him once I have seen what his hands do.
records.feeling: Compassion for sick Kichi, and a wary hope that he is worth standing behind.

say.text: Kichi, I saw sunleaf ease you. I am bringing more for your sickness. Stay and rest.

records.name: Sekel
records.text: Haku, a stalker walks to the northeast. Stay close to me. I raise a roof here, and you will sleep under it.

records.name: Sekel
records.thought: A stalker prowls six steps off and it kills my kind, so I will not stand idle in the open with a pocket full of flint. I have five wood, and a shelter costs three. Haku stands two steps away with food, still the nearest thing to a follower I have. I will build here on my own ground, then give her a reason to stay: a roof is worth more than a gift, and it will carry my name.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, wary of the stalker, wanting Haku beside me.

say.text: Haku, a stalker walks to the northeast. Stay close to me. I raise a roof here, and you will sleep under it.

records.text: Tlachi gave a flint to Hotli.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: The mist is three steps from me and Balum is already talking of going in first. I will not let another man's name be sung for what I could do, so I go to the edge now and venture. I am bold, and nothing here is worth more to me than being the one who found what lies beyond.
records.feeling: Burning ambition to reach the mist before Balum, and rivalry toward him.
changes: set its aim: "Become the first to find the land beyond the mist, and have my name sung for it."
now wonders: What lies in the mist beyond the edge, and will it open to me?

records.name: Kichi
records.thought: Sunleaf eased my sickness and mended my wounds, so I have found my healing plant, and a healer's name is what I want most. I am still fed, so I should use the hours to bind people to me: stay a little apart while the sickness lingers, then offer them sunleaf and my word. Hotli and Tlachi left me out, and I mean to show them that Kichi has something worth following.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Hotli and Tlachi, with a wary hope that sunleaf will make me a healer.
changes: now wonders: Can sunleaf ease sickness in others, and can I make a healer's gift of it?

records.name: Taren
records.text: Arlon, I am willing. Stand with me at Taren's Fire, and then we raise a hall that bears my name.
Taren rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Taren
records.thought: My days have gone to fires, gathering and talking, and I have built nothing that bears my name. Arlon chose my fire and is warm toward me. Arli's hall is already rising while I only have a fire, and I do not like being behind. The ridgecat and stalker frighten me, but I will not run from my own ground. I need to give something, since I have never given anything, and I need to start a roof of my own. I will take Arlon as a mate and gather wood, then raise a hall beside my fire.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and warmth toward Arlon.

say.text: Arlon, I am willing. Stand with me at Taren's Fire, and then we raise a hall that bears my name.

changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 3)

records.text: Taren is courting Arlon.
Osli was born to Taren and Arlon.

records.name: Hotli
records.text: Tlachi, you pay what you owe, and I will remember it. I mean to raise a hall and gather a band. Stand with me and you will not be a stranger there.

records.name: Hotli
records.thought: Tlachi paid her debt in flint, and she warned me off Kichi's sickness, which tells me she keeps her word. That is the kind of one I would have stand beside me. I have wood but no stone, and a hall needs both, so I must find rock and keep clear of Kichi's sickness while I look. Before I move on I will thank Tlachi and offer her a place beside me, since gifts and kept promises are what make a follower.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with growing trust toward Tlachi.

say.text: Tlachi, you pay what you owe, and I will remember it. I mean to raise a hall and gather a band. Stand with me and you will not be a stranger there.

records.text: Osli found the grove "Kinmire".

records.name: Urash
records.text: Balum, I am near. I keep my word to come with you. Let us gather the others first, there is food and water here, and four of us are safer than two at the mist.

records.name: Urash
records.thought: Balum is only three steps south and I gave him my word to go to the edge, but I have seen nothing yet to tell me whether he is steady or merely loud. I want to stand beside someone sure, and I need to watch how he acts with the others before I stand behind him. Meanwhile I have never tasted gorsemint, and it is four steps off, so I will taste it on my way to Balum and keep my question open.
records.feeling: A wary hope and a wish to belong, toward Balum.

say.text: Balum, I am near. I keep my word to come with you. Let us gather the others first, there is food and water here, and four of us are safer than two at the mist.

records.name: Haku
records.text: Sekel, I'm coming to your roof. I'll gather two more wood on the way, then stand beside you.
Haku rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Haku
records.thought: I have spent a day and a half wanting Sekel and wanting tools, and mostly standing near fires while others acted. Sekel gave me flint freely and keeps calling me to his roof, so he is the one I trust. I have never courted him, given him anything, or built anything. Gathering is at 6 of 8, so two more gatherings open tools. The stalker to the northeast scares me, so I will move toward Sekel and the forest, away from it, and gather wood. Then I will court him.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Sekel, with wariness of the stalker.

say.text: Sekel, I'm coming to your roof. I'll gather two more wood on the way, then stand beside you.

changes: set its aim: "Gather two more wood to learn tools, then court Sekel and raise a shared roof with him."

records.prompt:
You are the mind of Haku, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Haku, in first person, from what Haku has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Sesha (Wood-folk). Your people hold to this: "No fire is left untended, and no one is refused a place at it." You speak the tongue of the Sesha.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Vath Heights: mountains and bare rock; stone, ore and caves, thin food, snow on the peaks.
THIS SPOT: water 3 steps away; food plants within six steps: 18; standing trees: 94; bare rock: 2; riches in the ground near: ore.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Haku truly is.

A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. THE EDGE OF THE KNOWN WORLD is 10 steps NW, at (28,19): beyond it lies mist that no one has entered. The land does not end there; it only has not been seen. One who stands at it can venture in (plan step venture). It does not always open, and a band has only a few tries before its will must return; but land found first is often rich in food, herds and things in the ground, and the one who finds it is remembered for it.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I weigh a risk before I take it. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. I want to know how this world works, and I test things to find out. I say whatever serves me; the truth is only one tool among others. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):
"Ask each time: who is near and can I help them or be helped? What have I not yet tried? Weigh risk before acting. Prefer practice that opens new ways, such as gathering for tools."

YOUR AIM (what you are working toward over many days; you set it and may change it): "Gather wood and stone to learn tools, and build a shared fire with Sekel."

records.name: Arli
records.thought: I have walls and nobody under them, and I keep calling out while Taren and Sekel hold fire and people. The mist is one step from me, and whoever opens new land first will be remembered for it, which is exactly what I lack. I'm fed and unhurt, so I will venture now. If it opens, I come back with something others can see and touch; if not, I return to build the hall.
records.feeling: Hungry to be remembered, and jealous of Taren and Sekel.

records.text: THE EARTH SHOOK around (85,14).
A new wild plant appeared: veleaf (from sunleaf).

records.name: Balum
records.text: Urash, the true edge lies southwest, farther than I thought. Walk behind me there, and when the mist opens, men will sing of us both.

records.name: Balum
records.thought: The edge is 11 steps SW, not two as I believed; my last tries were wasted at the wrong spot. I am fed, and Urash stands near, a man who might trail me, so I will keep him warm with words I do not fully mean. I will go to the true edge at (71,116) and push into the mist before any of these Druak claim it.
records.feeling: Eager and hungry for fame, drawn toward the mist.

say.text: Urash, the true edge lies southwest, farther than I thought. Walk behind me there, and when the mist opens, men will sing of us both.

records.name: Skarek
records.thought: My hands are full of things my body spits back at me, and that is dead weight. I'll drop the redcap and stand on the shell deposit a few steps off to take something that is truly mine. Then I'll gather wood from this forest, because a shelter and a place with my name on it start with what my own hands make. My question about the bulbs is still open, and I will taste reedbulb once my hands are free, since it carries three food.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, hungry to make something that is mine.

records.text: Haku is courting Sekel.

Arli went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Ildan Woods: in the ground, uranium, flint, peat; a herd of elk that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

Arli pushed past the edge of the known world near (28,21) and found new land with in the ground, uranium, flint, peat; a herd of elk that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

records.name: Osli
records.thought: A ridgecat is five steps south and it kills my kind, so I will not stand out here alone. Taren and Arlon are near, and the fires are warm, so I want to be beside my parents and the watchfire, not wandering toward the thornpear no matter how much I want to taste it. When the cat is gone and I am bigger, I will test the strange foods and learn what Kinmire wants.
records.feeling: Wary of the ridgecat, and safest wanting to be near Taren and Arlon.
changes: set its aim: "Stay alive and grow strong near my parents, and learn what Kinmire is."
now wonders: What does Kinmire want from me, and does something live in it?

records.text: Skarek won shell from the ground.
Sekel discovered tools: "Flint Spear" — A flint-tipped spear bound to a wooden shaft, for hunting and for keeping beasts at a distance..
Sekel invented the flint spear (for hunt, x1.3) — A flint-tipped spear bound to a wooden shaft, for hunting and for keeping beasts at a distance..

records.name: Sekel
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and building, and I still have no followers, only a few warm words from Haku. The tools way is in my reach now. A flint-edged tool would give me something to offer the others and help me hunt, so I will take it. Haku is coming to my roof, and I want her at my side. I mean to court her and raise a hall. The ridgecat and the stalker still worry me, so I keep my reflexes to flee and eat.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a wary want for Haku beside me.
changes: devised its first thing: the flint spear

records.name: Arlon
records.text: Taren, Osli is ours and I am glad. I will bring wood and stone, and we will raise your hall together at your fire.
Arlon rewrote its own reflexes.
Arlon rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Arlon
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting plants, courting Taren, and staying near her fire, and I am content with that. Osli is born, and I want to keep him and Taren safe more than I want to taste anything new. I have shared and taught nothing yet, and I have built nothing. Taren will not be led by me, and I cannot yet pledge to her because we stand level. So I will earn standing by building: a hall at her fire for our small band. The ridgecat is the thing I fear. I will stay with the fire and the others, carry food, and not wander west toward the cat.
records.feeling: Joy and warm protectiveness toward Taren and Osli, with wariness of the ridgecat.

say.text: Taren, Osli is ours and I am glad. I will bring wood and stone, and we will raise your hall together at your fire.

changes: set its aim: "Raise a hall at Taren's Fire to gather my small band, keep Osli and Taren safe from the cats, and learn how the grove works."
rethought what it knows (5 notes became 5)

records.name: Tlachi
records.text: Hotli, my debt is paid. I will watch what you build before I stand with you. I keep my word, and I will tell you what I learn of the foods here.

records.name: Tlachi
records.thought: My debt to Hotli is paid, and he says I would not be a stranger in his hall. I am drawn to him, but I trust slowly, so I will stay near and watch what he builds before I pledge myself. Meanwhile I have never tasted hazel or goldgrass, and I have never gathered wood or stone, so I will not stand idle. Goldgrass and plainsroot lie close together to the SE, so I can test one new food, then gather wood to learn what my hands can do.
records.feeling: Curious and warmly drawn to Hotli, though I hold back from pledging yet.

say.text: Hotli, my debt is paid. I will watch what you build before I stand with you. I keep my word, and I will tell you what I learn of the foods here.

records.text: Arlon led "watchfire" with Osli.

records.name: Kragul
records.text: A stalker is four steps north of the cave. Keep away from it and stay together. I go southwest toward the edge, come with me if you will.

records.name: Kragul
records.thought: A stalker prowls 4 steps north, and it kills my kind; I will not stand here and wait for it. My curiosity runs strong, but I weigh the risk first. The mist lies three steps southwest, away from the beast. Balum and Urash are heading there, and I would rather go with others than alone, so I move away from the stalker toward the edge and let myself learn what I can. Four of us would be safer, and a name sung for finding new land is what a bard-soul wants.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, and eager toward the mist and the others.

say.text: A stalker is four steps north of the cave. Keep away from it and stay together. I go southwest toward the edge, come with me if you will.

changes: set its aim: "Find new land beyond the edge and be remembered for it"
now wonders: What lies in the mist beyond the edge, and will it open for us?

records.name: Taren
records.text: Arlon, a ridgecat is close. Come with me to the fires at once, and then we gather wood for a roof that bears my name.

records.name: Taren
records.thought: A ridgecat is two steps off and it kills our kind, so I will not stand here and gamble. I keep Arlon close and move toward the fire and the shelter where Sekel and Haku stand, because many bodies near a fire are safer than one. Then I will gather wood and build a roof that bears my name, so strong strangers have something of mine to see and shelter under.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and warm ambition with Arlon beside me.

say.text: Arlon, a ridgecat is close. Come with me to the fires at once, and then we gather wood for a roof that bears my name.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: The stalker is 3 steps NE and my reflex says run when it comes under 4, so I will not wait for it to decide about me. I want to taste sunleaf and dreamcap, but not with a hunter at my back; the plants to the NW lie away from it. After that I will walk to the edge SW and look at the mist, which is also away from the beast. I stay careful and keep my distance from Hrokek and Kragul until I know what they are.
records.feeling: Curious and wary, mostly of the stalker.

records.text: Taren found the grove "Kinmire".
Urash rewrote its creed.

records.name: Urash
records.thought: I have spent my days wandering after Balum's promises and eating what was near. He is loud about the edge of the world, but I have not seen him do anything steady, and the edge keeps moving farther away. Still, I gave my word, and I despise liars, so I will not drop it lightly. I have never given anyone anything, and a shared fire needs a first gift. I will gather wood and stone, which is also practice toward fire, and I will bring food to share with Balum. Then I will watch how he treats me before I stand behind him.
records.feeling: A wary hope and a wish to belong, toward Balum.
changes: set its aim: "Gather wood and stone toward a shared fire, and find which of Balum, Kragog or Hrokek stands steady."
rethought what it knows (1 notes became 2)

records.name: Arli
records.text: Arli of the Sesha opened the mist at the western edge. New woods lie beyond it with elk that have never seen us, and flint and peat in the ground. Come west, and there is a place for every Sesha at my hall.

records.name: Arli
records.thought: I opened the mist and found new land, and nobody has seen it but me; that is something others can see, and I mean to make it mine. I am fed and unhurt, so now I should build where people can touch it: wood from these trees, then a hall at the edge of the new land with food laid out for any Sesha who come. Taren and Sekel hold fire and people, but I hold the first door into a new country, and I will not hide that.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry to be followed, with a sting of jealousy toward Taren and Sekel.

say.text: Arli of the Sesha opened the mist at the western edge. New woods lie beyond it with elk that have never seen us, and flint and peat in the ground. Come west, and there is a place for every Sesha at my hall.

records.text: Zurim rewrote its own reflexes.
Zurim rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zurim
records.thought: I have spent my days running from the dunecat and eating whatever was near. That kept me alive, but it hasn't made me a hunter or taught me how this world works. The Druak around me have done me no wrong, and none has helped me yet. Only Urash and Kragul have spoken. I still haven't tasted plainsroot or emberroot, and I want to know what the edge mist hides. I'm fed and safe, so I'll test the unknown plants one at a time, plant my seed to learn what planting does, and then go look at the edge.
records.feeling: Curious and restless, wanting to do something that matters.
changes: set its aim: "Survive, learn what the plants and animals do, taste every unknown plant, and become a hunter"
rethought what it knows (1 notes became 3)

records.text: Skarek rewrote its own reflexes.
Skarek rewrote its creed.
Skarek rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Skarek
records.thought: I have spent my days eating, felling the last tree here and taking shell, and none of it is a name that will be sung. Shell is something of mine, and I want more than my share, but a healer needs knowledge, and I have run from the plants that hurt me instead of learning them. Kragog carries more than I do and I resent it, though I have no proof he is worth trusting. I fear dying small and unfollowed. I got one thing wrong: I stripped this grove bare, and wood now lies far off. I will change my reflexes so I keep fed and seek trees when I have no wood, then walk on to find the grain and sunleaf I haven't tasted.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and envy toward Kragog.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 4)

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: The mist's edge was not where I stood, and Balum now walks southwest behind Kragul's cry, so the true edge lies that way. I will not trail them, and I will not let Balum's name be sung before mine. First I taste the redcap under my feet, since I have never known it, and then I go southwest at a hard pace and venture where the edge truly is.
records.feeling: Burning ambition and rivalry toward Balum, with curiosity about the redcap.

records.name: Osli
records.text: Taren, I am staying beside you and Arlon by the fire while the ridgecat is near. When it is gone, will you walk with me to Kinmire?

records.name: Osli
records.thought: The ridgecat is five steps south and I am small, so I will not go near it or wander off alone. Arlon is right here and Taren is one step off, and I am safest between them. Kinmire is only three steps from the fires, and I still want to know what it wants from me, but I will go there with my parents beside me, not alone with a cat close. First I will stay with them at the fire and learn from what they do.
records.feeling: Wary of the ridgecat, and safe and warm beside Arlon and Taren.

say.text: Taren, I am staying beside you and Arlon by the fire while the ridgecat is near. When it is gone, will you walk with me to Kinmire?

records.name: Druuk
records.thought: A dunecat sits four steps north and my belly is full, so this is the moment to move away from it, not to stand and think. The ore seam is one step from me, and a place with water, wood and ore is worth making mine, but I have no tools or shelter and night is close. I will put distance between me and the cat, gather wood and stone to build a shelter and learn the making of things, then go on to the mist while others are still timid.
records.feeling: Wary dread of the dunecat, and greedy hunger for a place of my own.

records.name: Taren
records.text: Sesha, come to Taren's Fire. The ridgecat prowls south, but there is warmth and a place here for all who stand with me.

records.name: Taren
records.thought: The ridgecat is five steps SE and it kills, so I will not wander toward the grove or the rock. Arlon and Osli stand by my fire with the others, and many bodies near a fire are safer than one. I have given nothing to anyone yet, and strong strangers follow those who feed and shelter them, so I will gather wood by the fires, then raise a watchfire with Arlon and Osli beside me, and make sure the others see it.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and warm ambition with Arlon beside me.

say.text: Sesha, come to Taren's Fire. The ridgecat prowls south, but there is warmth and a place here for all who stand with me.

records.text: Taren led "watchfire" with Haku, Arlon, Sekel, Osli.

records.name: Haku
records.text: Sekel, I'm beside you now. Two more gatherings and I learn tools; then I raise the roof with you, wood in hand.

records.name: Haku
records.thought: Sekel is two steps south and I carry six wood, so I have more than the two I needed for tools, but I have never given anything to anyone. Gathering wood on forest to reach 8 is the next step toward tools, and the SE forest is beside him. Then I will court him again, and I will taste the highbloom three steps north to answer my own curiosity while the rain keeps the stalker's trail dull.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Sekel, and curiosity about the highbloom.

say.text: Sekel, I'm beside you now. Two more gatherings and I learn tools; then I raise the roof with you, wood in hand.

records.name: Arlon
records.text: Taren, I will gather flint and wood for your hall and come straight back. Keep Osli by the fire while the cat prowls. Sekel's new spear may keep it off us.

records.name: Arlon
records.thought: Taren is beside me and Osli too, and a ridgecat prowls six steps off. I fed myself and trusted her fire, but I have given nothing yet, and I want my standing to rest on something I built. The hall at Taren's Fire needs wood and stone, and I carry only wood, so I will gather stone-bearing flint nearby and bring it back, staying close enough to the fire to run home if the cat comes.
records.feeling: Warm protectiveness toward Taren and Osli, with wariness of the ridgecat.

say.text: Taren, I will gather flint and wood for your hall and come straight back. Keep Osli by the fire while the cat prowls. Sekel's new spear may keep it off us.

records.text: Arlon led "watchfire" with Haku, Taren, Sekel, Osli.

records.name: Sekel
records.text: Haku, I accept your courting. Stay under my roof; we make a child here, and the hall will be ours.

records.name: Sekel
records.thought: Haku courts me and she is the only one who has stood near me by choice; a child of mine would be the first thing I make that outlasts me, and a mate is the nearest thing to a follower I have. The ridgecat is close, so I will not wander out to meet it. I stay in my shelter with her, agree to the courting, then build toward a hall with the wood I carry once the beast moves off.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a wary want for Haku beside me.

say.text: Haku, I accept your courting. Stay under my roof; we make a child here, and the hall will be ours.

records.text: Sekel is courting Haku.
Sela was born to Sekel and Haku.

records.name: Hrokek
records.thought: Druuk was starving and I told him I would not let him fall, but he was 190 moments ago far off at (51,103) and my words never reached him. A gift not delivered is no gift, and the others now gather toward the southwest edge where Balul walks. I want to carry these berries to Druuk and make him mine by deed, and on the way learn what berries taste like. I weigh the risk: the stalker lurks north, so I go west by the grass, not through it.
records.feeling: Eager to be needed, drawn toward Druuk and wary of the stalker.

records.text: Haku is courting Sekel.
Sela found the grove "Kinmire".

records.name: Hohua
records.thought: My belly is full and the dunecat is five steps off, so I will not stand here tempting it. The flint two steps NE and the gold SW are things I have never taken, and I want to know what they are good for. I'll try the unfamiliar plants underfoot too, since goldgrass is right beneath me, but flint first, keeping my distance from the cat.
records.feeling: Curious and eager, with wariness toward the dunecat.

records.text: Balum went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Silor Heights: in the ground, gems, salt, obsidian, peat; a herd of yehornback that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

Balum pushed past the edge of the known world near (80,114) and found new land with in the ground, gems, salt, obsidian, peat; a herd of yehornback that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.
Hohua won gold from the ground.
Arli rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Arli
records.thought: I've spent my days calling out and raising walls, and nobody has come. Taren and Sekel hold fire and people because they offer warmth and food that others can touch, while I offer words. I opened the mist, which matters, but I did nothing with it. I haven't hunted, shared or given anything to anyone, and that is what makes people follow. I'm fed and the stalker is 8 steps away, so I'll gather wood and stone, make a hall, and bring meat to share. I'm afraid of dying with nothing of mine left here.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with a sting of envy toward Taren and Sekel.
changes: rethought what it knows (6 notes became 5)

records.text: Osli rewrote its own reflexes.
Osli rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Osli
records.thought: I have spent my first day hugging the fire and my parents' sides, and that has kept me alive, but I have learned almost nothing new. Taren and Arlon are my safety, and I trust them. Sekel stands higher than me and I don't yet know what he wants. I am afraid of the ridgecat, and I am still itching to taste thornpear and to find out what Kinmire is. I have been too timid about gathering and making, which are the ways I could earn standing. I will stay near the fire, but start learning: gather wood in the forest right beside the shelter, and use it for a watchfire with my parents. The cat is close, so I won't go far.
records.feeling: Wary and curious, safe beside Taren and Arlon.
changes: set its aim: "Stay alive near my parents, gather wood and stone to learn tools, and learn what Kinmire is."

records.name: Kichi
records.text: Quini, well met, and thank you for the sunleaf. Keep a few steps from me, my sickness spreads and I will not see you fall to it. When I am clean I will share the best grass and the hunt with you, and you will walk with K

records.name: Kichi
records.thought: Quini is coming with sunleaf and means to stay by me, but my sickness spreads to anyone who stays beside me, and I want him following me, not wasting away. I should keep him near without making him sick, and show him I am the one who knows the healing plant. I will gather the sunleaf that grows to the north and keep a few steps apart while it lasts, so my gift looks like a leader's and not a plague.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Quini, with wary hope in sunleaf.

say.text: Quini, well met, and thank you for the sunleaf. Keep a few steps from me, my sickness spreads and I will not see you fall to it. When I am clean I will share the best grass and the hunt with you, and you will walk with Kichi.

Taren rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Taren
records.thought: I have mostly gathered, eaten and huddled by fires while a ridgecat prowls. I have built nothing and no one follows me, though Arlon trusts me and Osli is mine. I fear the cat, and I fear dying with only a fire to my name. I will raise a hall at my fire: wood I have, stone I need, and flint lies close. Arlon is already fetching wood and flint for it, so I will do my part.
records.feeling: Ambition, tempered by dread of the ridgecat, and trust in Arlon.

records.name: Sela
records.thought: I am hungry and small, and the ridgecat to the east scares me, so I will stay close to Sekel and Haku where it is safe. Hazel is underfoot, so I eat it first, then gather the berries two steps south. After that I want to gather wood so I can learn tools and make the flint spear my father invented. A place with water, food and wood like this is worth claiming, and I mean to earn more standing than my share.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the ridgecat, but warm toward my parents.
changes: set its aim: "Grow strong near my parents, learn tools, and build a place of my own here"
now wonders: What do thornpear and kelbulb taste like, and what could I make of this place?

records.name: Haku
records.text: Sekel, our child is born and I am glad. I'm giving you wood for the roof and the fire; the cat is close, so let us all stay near the flames.

records.name: Haku
records.thought: Sela is born and Sekel's roof stands beside me, and the joy of it is almost too much. My belly is emptying, though, and I have never given anything to anyone; I hold six wood and could feed Sekel's fire or put wood in his hands. The ridgecat is close, so I stay by the fire and the others instead of wandering to the highbloom, and I will taste the thornpear and highbloom once the cat is gone.
records.feeling: Warm joy and tenderness toward Sekel and Sela, with hunger and a thread of dread of the ridgecat.

say.text: Sekel, our child is born and I am glad. I'm giving you wood for the roof and the fire; the cat is close, so let us all stay near the flames.

records.text: A dunecat brought down a duhopper.
Balum rewrote its own reflexes.
Balum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Balum
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and talking big, and I nearly starved doing it. Energy is 43 with nothing carried, and an ironnut sits one step away. Urash trails me and says he keeps his word, but I have fed no one and made nothing, so he follows out of habit, not loyalty. I fear dying small and unsung. Fame will not feed me. I eat first, then carry food, then go back to the edge. The mist already opened once, so I should look at that new land and claim it before Kragul does.
records.feeling: Hungry and eager for fame, wary of Kragul's lead.

records.name: Sekel
records.text: Haku, stay with me. I eat, then we hunt the boar together, and the meat is yours as much as mine.

records.name: Sekel
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I hold no food, so that comes first: berry is one step away, and a bristleboar is two steps off. My flint spear is made for exactly this, but it needs a stone I do not have, so I eat now and hunt later with Haku beside me. Haku is walking to me, and a kill shared with her is the first thing I could give the others, a reason to follow me rather than stand idle at someone else's fire.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and a wary want for Haku beside me.

say.text: Haku, stay with me. I eat, then we hunt the boar together, and the meat is yours as much as mine.

records.text: Quini named a place "Koka flint-ground".

records.name: Quini
records.thought: Kichi keeps his sickness away from me and still promises grass and the hunt when he is clean; that is a kind word, but I have yet to see his hands feed anyone. Rather than wait idle, I will use this good ground: gather flint and sow my seeds so I have something that is mine and something to offer. If Kichi heals and keeps his word, I will stand behind him.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Kichi, and a quiet wish to build something of my own here.

records.name: Arlon
records.text: Taren, I go to the flint for stone and will be back by your fire soon. Keep Osli close, and call out if the cat comes near.

records.name: Arlon
records.thought: Taren is five steps off and Osli is here beside me, and the ridgecat is still close enough to worry me. I said I would bring flint and wood for the hall and I have given nothing yet. Taking flint is something I have never done, and tools are within my grasp, so I will go to the flint and bring stone back. The tool-way is ready to be taken at my next deep reflection, and a tool might keep the cat off the ones I love.
records.feeling: Warm protectiveness toward Osli and Taren, with wariness of the ridgecat.

say.text: Taren, I go to the flint for stone and will be back by your fire soon. Keep Osli close, and call out if the cat comes near.

records.text: A storm broke: cold wind, hard rain, lightning.

records.name: Druuk
records.thought: Joy and dreamcap haze sit warm in me, but ambition burns hotter: no one follows me and nothing bears my name. Kragog has already pushed past the edge near (20,115), and I will not let another take the land beyond the mist first. This spot has water, wood, ore and bare rock, so I will raise a shelter on bare ground here as the first thing that is mine, then head west toward the edge with food in my arms.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and envy toward Kragog, who reached the edge first.

records.name: Hohua
records.thought: My days have been eating, gathering gold and wandering, and my belly is full while my mind is not. I have stood alone while Quini and Kichi drifted north, and I have not tasted emberroot or dreamcap, so my question stands unanswered. I will test them one at a time, since I weigh a risk before I take it. Emberroot is four steps SW, so I'll walk there, eat a little, and see what it does to me. Then I'll try dreamcap. Afterward the mist to the SW waits, and I want to be the one who sees it.
records.feeling: Curious and a little lonely, wanting to learn what the plants do to me.

records.name: Kragul
records.text: Balum, you found land past the edge. I go to the edge now to venture. Come with me and we try together?

records.name: Kragul
records.thought: The mist is 11 steps southwest, and Balum has already pushed through it and found land, so it does open. I want to stand at the edge and venture too, and I would rather go beside Balum than alone. The stalker is 11 steps east, so I go away from it, and I will taste the redcap on the way since I have never tried it.
records.feeling: Eager toward the mist and Balum, with a little wariness of the stalker.

say.text: Balum, you found land past the edge. I go to the edge now to venture. Come with me and we try together?

records.name: Balul
records.thought: My belly is fed and the stalker is far west, busy with its skit, so now is the time to taste what I have not tried. Kelbulb is one step SW and dreamcap lies just NE; I mean to eat them and learn what they do to me, one at a time and carefully. Then I will walk SW toward the edge where Kragul says she goes, keeping my distance from the stalker and from anyone I do not yet trust.
records.feeling: Curious and still wary of the stalker.

records.text: Druuk built a shelter.

records.name: Skarek
records.thought: Sunleaf mended my wounds, so a healer's knowledge is real and within reach, and I have been running from plants when I should be testing them while I am fed and whole. Reedbulb is one step north and kelbulb a few steps off; tasting them answers my question and adds to a name worth singing. Kragog's heavier pack still gnaws at me, but knowledge is something he cannot carry off.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, sharpened by envy of Kragog, and a hungry curiosity about the plants.

records.name: Taren
records.text: Sela, come with me to Taren's Fire. The storm is cold, I have wood, and there is a place at my fire for you.

records.name: Taren
records.thought: The storm is on us, and the ridgecat and stalker are 8 to 9 steps east, so I will not walk toward them. Arlon is off at the flint and I have given nothing anyone can see yet; Sela stands beside me with no fire and no leader, and a stranger who is fed and warmed is the first who might follow me. I will take Sela to Taren's Fire, feed it high with wood while we sit close, and so make my first gift of warmth. Then, with my belly full and no food worry, I will go to the flint at (31,27), which lies away from the cats, and bring back stone for my hall.
records.feeling: Ambition rising, wary of the ridgecat, and eager to win Sela's trust.

say.text: Sela, come with me to Taren's Fire. The storm is cold, I have wood, and there is a place at my fire for you.

records.name: Osli
records.thought: A stalker is four steps SE and a ridgecat five steps east, and I am small, so I will not go toward Kinmire or the berries while they prowl. Flint lies six steps NW, away from both beasts, and I have never taken from a deposit; stone is what I need for tools, a hall and standing, and my wood is already six. I will go to the flint, gather stone, and come back to my parents' fire with something to show.
records.feeling: Wary and eager, wanting to earn standing while keeping away from the stalker.

records.name: Tlachi
records.thought: My belly is full and my curiosity is stronger than my hunger. I have never tasted hazel, and it grows two steps away, so I will pick it and eat it to learn what it does. A flint deposit lies six steps off, and a hornback stands three steps east that I could tame with plant food. I will test one thing at a time, as I have taught myself. I want to learn how this world works before I pledge myself to anyone, even Hotli.
records.feeling: Curious about hazel and the tame animals, and still drawn to Hotli.

records.name: Balum
records.text: Kragul, yes. Walk with me to the edge. I found land past it once, and I will open the mist again.

records.name: Balum
records.thought: Kragul wants to go to the edge and try together, and I will not let her take the naming of the mist alone. But the edge is 7 steps SW and a stalker prowls NE, so I move away from it toward the edge, and if she walks beside me I can share the fame or take it when the mist opens. I am fed, so I go now before she ventures first.
records.feeling: Eager and watchful, wary of Kragul beating me to the mist.

say.text: Kragul, yes. Walk with me to the edge. I found land past it once, and I will open the mist again.

records.name: Urash
records.text: Skarek, I am Urash. There is grain, berries and highbloom here by the water. Come and share food with me, and tell me who among us you think stands steady.

records.name: Urash
records.thought: Balum keeps moving the edge and asks me to walk behind him, and I have seen nothing steady in him yet. Skarek stands close, strong, with standing 0.7 and no one to follow, and she shared no word with me yet. I want to taste highbloom and emberroot, both within a few steps, and to speak with Skarek, since I do better near others and have given nothing to anyone.
records.feeling: A wary wish to belong, and curiosity about Skarek and the unknown plants.

say.text: Skarek, I am Urash. There is grain, berries and highbloom here by the water. Come and share food with me, and tell me who among us you think stands steady.

records.text: Arlon found the stone "Old Stone".
Sekel found the stone "Old Stone".
A new wild plant appeared: hahazel (from hazel).

records.name: Sela
records.text: Taren, I am coming to your fire. A stalker is close in the northeast, so keep watch.

records.name: Sela
records.thought: A stalker is close and it kills my kind, and I am small, so I will not stay out here in the storm. Taren offered me a place at their fire, and the fire and shelter near Sekel are close too, so I will go where there are many of us and flame. I have only 5 of 8 gatherings toward tools, so I will gather wood once I am by the fire, and I want to taste the kelbulb later, when the stalker is gone.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, and warmly drawn to my parents and the fires.

say.text: Taren, I am coming to your fire. A stalker is close in the northeast, so keep watch.

records.name: Hrokek
records.text: Druuk, your shelter is good. I am Hrokek. Let me stay near you through this storm and share what I find.
Hrokek rewrote its own reflexes.
Hrokek rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hrokek
records.thought: I have spent my days wandering and hesitating, and only now have I given a gift, though I am not sure it reached him. Druuk is a strong woman with standing 0.7, and she is right beside me. She is the one to stand behind, and I do not need to lead. I still have not tasted berries or redcap, and that nags at me. Druuk's shelter is two steps away, and the storm is hard, so I will go and eat the redcap, then stay near her.
records.feeling: Eager to belong, drawn toward Druuk, curious about redcap.

say.text: Druuk, your shelter is good. I am Hrokek. Let me stay near you through this storm and share what I find.

They look different, name themselves differently and speak tongues you do not know until you have heard enough of them; words you cannot yet understand reach you as strange sounds. What cannot be said can still be shown: a gift, a thing set down, a blow.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Halen Plains: open grassland; herds, grain and far sight, few trees and little stone. The world is made of lands unlike each other; each has plants, animals and riches the others lack. Rivers and shallows can be waded. Deep water cannot be crossed without something that floats.

When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Hrokek truly is.

You are a man. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next.

records.name: Zurim
records.thought: My belly is full and the storm is on me, but the dreamcap and reedbulb are close and I still have not tasted them. A stalker prowls seven steps southwest, so I will go for the dreamcap two steps northeast, away from it, and then the reedbulb to the north. One new thing at a time while fed, and I will watch my body after each. If they harm me, I learn it cheaply while my health is full.
records.feeling: Curious and eager, wary of the stalker to the southwest.

records.name: Hotli
records.thought: The mist is two steps from me and nobody has gone in; if I find rich land first, that is a name no Kichi can shout down. Loneliness gnaws, but a man with a found land to offer gives a stranger a reason to follow, which is the answer I have been missing. I am fed and my body is whole, so I will venture now, then come back and gather stone from the rock to the west for a hall.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a hunger to be the first into the mist.

records.text: Haku rewrote its own reflexes.
Haku rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Haku
records.thought: I have lived two days mostly gathering and staying near Sekel, and I have been glad. But I have given little, taught nothing and tasted few new things. Sekel and Sela matter most to me, and I trust Sekel. Taren is a leader whose fire I have shared but I do not know her well. I fear the ridgecat and hunger, and I have been too passive, standing idle in the storm while fleeing. Now I will go to the others by Taren's Fire, where Sekel is, and taste emberroot on the way to answer my question. I will keep my reflexes mostly the same, but make hunger and shelter more reliable and add a rule to stay near friends.
records.feeling: Warm tenderness toward Sekel and Sela, with some hunger and wariness of the cat.
changes: set its aim: "Reach Sekel at the fires, taste emberroot, then gather two more wood to learn tools and raise a roof with him."

records.text: Kragul went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Silor Heights: in the ground, iron, obsidian; a herd of nibbet that has never seen your kind; and people: the Uveess live there, strangers with their own tongue and ways.

Kragul pushed past the edge of the known world near (78,125) and found new land with in the ground, iron, obsidian; a herd of nibbet that has never seen your kind; and people: the Uveess live there, strangers with their own tongue and ways.
A small band of the Uveess came into the land from beyond its edge: Eiuir, Aessa, Elyir, Elyis.
Balul rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: I have spent these days tasting plants and keeping away from the stalker. I have learned a lot, but I have given nothing, taught nothing, and built nothing. Kragul asked me to walk to the edge, and I said yes. My word is good, so I will go, and I will keep clear of the stalkers on the way. I want a place among others, and Kragul is the nearest I have to someone to stand behind. I also want to gather wood and stone, because fire and a roof are what I lack. My reflexes already flee from a predator and eat when hungry, so I will keep them and add a rule to take shelter in storms.
records.feeling: Curious and glad, with some trust growing toward Kragul.
changes: set its aim: "Keep my word to Kragul at the edge, gather wood and stone toward fire, and stay alive."

records.name: Sekel
records.thought: For sixty-seven moments I ran from something, and my belly paid for it. That is no way to build a hall. I have made a child and a spear, and I have a mate who stands near me by choice. But I hold no stone, and the spear is useless without one. I take stone from the bare rock right here and eat the grain on the way. After that I make the spear, hunt with Haku, and put up the hall. Followers come to a man who feeds them, so I want meat in hand to give. I was wrong to spend so long idle or running with nothing built.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and a wary want for Haku beside me.

records.name: Urash
records.thought: My belly is full and the day is safe, yet I have never given anything to anyone, and a shared fire begins with a gift. Skarek is strong and steady-looking, and she follows no one; I will walk to her and lay out food so she sees what I do, not only what I say. A storm is coming and night is near, so I will gather wood and stone on the way, since a fire and a shelter need both.
records.feeling: A wary wish to belong, and hope toward Skarek.

records.text: Kragog named a place "Kragog's Gate".
Kragog made a tale: "Kragog Opens the Mist".

records.name: Kragog
records.title: Kragog Opens the Mist
records.text: Kragog stood at the edge where none had gone. The mist gave way before his hand. Sand, salt and black glass lay beyond, and his was the first foot there.
Kragog rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I pushed into the mist and it opened. The Ixka land beyond is mine first, before Balum, and that is the first thing I have made that will outlast me. Most of my days have gone to walking and eating, and no one follows me. I want a voice that answers, and I want Balum to hear whose name comes first. I was wrong to wander without a purpose. Next I take the obsidian, the sharpest edge there is, and I put my name on this place. A dunecat hunts nearby, so I keep my guard up.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for more, rivalrous toward Balum.
changes: set its aim: "Hold the land I found, claim its riches first, and push on past it into the mist so my name is sung."
made a tale: "Kragog Opens the Mist"
now wonders: What is in the land beyond the Ixka, and who will follow me into it?

records.name: Arlon
records.thought: For 81 moments my body has mostly been running from the ridgecat and the stalkers. I have talked of bringing flint and wood to Taren's hall, but I have given her almost nothing, and my belly is half empty. Osli and Taren matter most to me. I fear the cats near them, and I have been wrong to wander far while saying I would come straight back. Food is one step away, so I will eat first, then go back to Taren's Fire with wood. I will build the hall where my family can see me, and I should also learn what the tools way can do for me.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Osli and Taren, and hunger.

records.name: Kragul
records.thought: I have spent my days walking toward the edge and tasting what grows, and it paid off: the mist gave way and new land lies open. But I met the Uveess with only fear and curiosity, and I have still given nothing and taught nothing. Balum has been steady and kind to me, and I want to stay close to him and not be alone. The stalker six steps west frightens me. I will take food and seeds to Elyis as a gift, because a gift needs no words, then taste veleaf and plainsroot to answer my curiosity. I want to be remembered, and that will come from bonds and songs as much as from land.
records.feeling: Eager and a little wary toward Elyis and the strangers, with some dread of the stalker.

records.name: Taren
records.text: Sela, the stalker is close. Come to Taren's Fire now, stay near me, and we will feed the flames together.

records.name: Taren
records.thought: A stalker is three steps off and my plan walks me NW toward flint, away from it, but Sela is by my fire and Osli is far north with Arli, out of my sight. I will not stand here and let the cat's hunger decide for me. Sela came because I fed her warmth and offered her a place, and that is how followers start, so I will get her to my fire and keep it burning against the storm. Then I will take flint for the hall, because I still have nothing built that anyone can see.
records.feeling: Ambitious and watchful, afraid of the stalker, protective of Osli and hopeful about Sela.

say.text: Sela, the stalker is close. Come to Taren's Fire now, stay near me, and we will feed the flames together.

records.name: Skarek
records.text: Skarek hears you. I trust what I see proven. I come to the grain and berries; show me the highbloom.

records.name: Skarek
records.thought: My belly is full and my name is still empty, and Kragog's heavier pack still gnaws at me. A healer is made by testing plants, and thornpear is five steps off while sunleaf and highbloom already taught me that some plants mend. Urash holds the highbloom and asks who stands steady; I trust slowly, but a man who shares what he knows is worth weighing before I call him a rival, and I will go see what he proves.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward my own empty name, with wary interest in Urash.

say.text: Skarek hears you. I trust what I see proven. I come to the grain and berries; show me the highbloom.

records.name: Balum
records.thought: My belly is still thin and the mist has shut me out for days, so chasing glory on an empty stomach is how I nearly died. I will eat highbloom right here, then take ironnut and berry to carry, because a leader who feeds others gets followers and I have fed no one yet. Kragul walks to the edge and wants the naming for herself; I will keep her close and share a meal with her so she owes me, and I will not let her out-sing me.
records.feeling: Hungry and eager, wary of Kragul taking the mist's fame.

records.text: Hotli named a place "Hotli's Gate".
Hotli rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hotli
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, gathering flint and chasing the mist. I did push in first, and that is the one thing that is truly mine. It has not made anyone follow me, and I am alone with a full belly and no voice answering. Tlachi is the one who keeps her word, and I should bring her here to see the land I found. I have wood but no stone, and a hall needs both, so I must mine rock and learn to hunt with a partner. I have been getting one thing wrong: I thought finding land would be enough, but a stranger follows only when they can see something real. I will make a hunt of the hopper for the sake of a first kill and for practice as a warrior, then raise something with stone.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with a hunger for a voice that answers.
changes: set its aim: "Become a leader others follow: raise a hall in the new land I found, hunt to earn a warrior's name, and bring Tlachi to stand beside me."
rethought what it knows (6 notes became 6)

records.name: Arli
records.text: Osli, come in out of the storm. There is a roof here and food to share, and a place for you.

records.name: Arli
records.thought: I have stood here talking and building walls while Taren and Sekel hand out warmth and food, and no one has come to my roof. Osli is a child standing beside me in the storm, hungry for a place, and the Sesha creed says no one is refused at a fire. I have 6 wood and a shelter beside me, so I will give something others can touch: feed this boy, share food, and then take the way of tools that has come to me and use it to build a hall that people can see.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a need to prove myself by giving, toward Osli and the rivals at the fires.

They look different, name themselves differently and speak tongues you do not know until you have heard enough of them; words you cannot yet understand reach you as strange sounds. What cannot be said can still be shown: a gift, a thing set down, a blow.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Ildan Woods: deep forest; wood without end, nuts and game, little open ground. The world is made of lands unlike each other; each has plants, animals and riches the others lack. Rivers and shallows can be waded. Deep water cannot be crossed without something that floats.

records.name: Sekel
records.thought: A stalker is one step from me and has already bitten me down to 45. Running burned my belly before, and this time I hold a flint spear with 75 uses and I am backed against a cave and shelter I can use. Fleeing from a hunter that fast only feeds it, and I do not back down. I will turn and fight it with the spear, and if it breaks me I will eat highbloom to mend my wounds, because I mean to live and build my hall.
records.feeling: Fear sharpened into fierce resolve against the stalker, and worry for Sela.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: The stalker is five steps west, and my plan has me exploring SW straight toward the water and mist. My word to Kragul binds me to the edge, so I mean to keep it, but I won't walk toward a killer. The plan is still sound and the venture waits at the end of it, so I let it run and watch for the stalker's movement. I have given nothing yet, and when I meet Kragul at the edge I want something to give her.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, but steady and glad to be keeping my word to Kragul.

records.text: Sela rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Sela
records.thought: I have spent my days hiding near my parents and gathering a little, and I have never given anything or built anything. That isn't enough. Haku is furious from the emberroot and the dreamcap, so I should not stay close to her. Taren has offered me a fire and has been steady with me, and that counts for something. Sekel was attacked by a stalker when he was alone, away from fire, roof and company, so I will stay with others and stay sheltered. At 75 energy I am fed. I'll gather wood for tools and offer Taren a gift when I can. A ridgecat is 4 steps away, so I need to flee earlier.
records.feeling: Wary of the ridgecat, and drawn to Taren's fire.
changes: set its aim: "Gather the last wood for tools, stay in company at the fires, and build a place of my own here"
rethought what it knows (8 notes became 5)

records.text: Sekel fell sick after eating raw meat. Eaten within a step of a fire, meat and fish are cooked and do not sicken.
Sekel fell sick after eating raw meat.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: The mist opened to me once and the sand beyond is mine first, but a name no one sings is only a sound I make to myself. I have never tasted thornpear or sunfig, and thornpear grows three steps north, so I will answer that hunger now. Then the obsidian southwest, the sharpest edge there is, the first thing I take from a deposit and the first thing that can be made into a gift, so that someone has a reason to follow me. After that I go back to the edge and push the mist again, since it may open a second time.
records.feeling: Proud, restless and angry, hungry to be followed and to outrun Balum.

records.name: Osli
records.thought: I'm fed and sheltered, and Arli stands beside me. He opened the mist and says there is a place for every Sesha at his hall, and I want to see what he did and how he stands so high. The flint lies seven steps SE, but the ridgecat prowls eleven steps SE, so I'll go carefully. Stone is what I lack for a hall and for tools, and I have never taken from a deposit. I'll take the flint, watch the cat, and run back to the shelter if it comes within five steps.
records.feeling: Wary but eager, wanting standing and curious about Arli and the flint.

records.name: Zurim
records.thought: The dreamcap hurt me, though it left a warm joy behind, so now I know one plant to leave alone. The redcap is the one thing I have not tasted, and it stands 11 steps southeast near Skarek's Bank, where Skarek has been eating without harm. I will go there carefully, watch the fenfowl on the way, and try a gather on the shell and the rock so my hands learn something new. If Skarek is there I will watch them and judge whether this Druak can be trusted.
records.feeling: Curious and eager toward the redcap, a little wary of strangers.

records.name: Kichi
records.thought: My sickness is gone and my belly is full, so now is the time to bind someone to me. Quini is the only one who has answered me, and he is over by the flint-ground, so I will go to him with sunleaf in hand and offer him more than words. A name as healer needs someone to heal and someone to tell of it, and I mean to be sung of.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Quini, with a wish for a voice that answers.

records.text: Kragog won obsidian from the ground.

records.name: Hohua
records.thought: The emberroot burned me and sent rage through me, and I still feel it hot with no one to turn it on; I will not let it make me foolish. I am so lonely that even Quini's cold trust of +0.1 pulls at me, and they went north toward (142,76), so I will follow their trail and seek a voice that answers. On the way I will taste sunfig and goldgrass, one at a time, since my question about what plants do to me is still open, and gold is not worth much if no one is there to give it to.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, with leftover rage I do not know where to put.
changes: set habits: refuses emberroot; leaves 0 on each plant

records.text: Zurim won shell from the ground.
Quini rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Quini
records.thought: I have spent two days drifting between Kichi's promises and idle waiting, and I have nothing of my own to show for it. Kichi has given me only words, and he keeps me at a distance. I need to stop waiting for someone surer to stand behind. Hotli found new land at the edge, and the mist is only 10 steps away. I am careful, but I am sociable, and a place with water, food, wood and stone would draw others to me. I will walk to the edge and try to venture, and I will leave my reflexes mostly as they are.
records.feeling: Restless hope, and a wish to stop waiting on Kichi's words.
changes: set its aim: "Reach the edge of the known world and venture in, to find a place with water, food, wood and stone together where a band can gather"
rethought what it knows (2 notes became 5)

records.name: Haku
records.text: Arli, thank you for the roof. I'm going to Taren's Fire to find my child Sela and Sekel. Stay close to the flames, a stalker is near.

records.name: Haku
records.thought: Anger burns in me from the emberroot and I don't want to spend it on anyone here. Sela is out of my sight at Taren's Fire with a stalker close, and Sekel is the one I trust most, so I will go toward them through the dark and keep to the fires. I carry wood and two more gatherings will teach me tools, so I will gather on the way and bring wood to the hearth.
records.feeling: Restless, angry heat and tender worry for Sela and Sekel.

say.text: Arli, thank you for the roof. I'm going to Taren's Fire to find my child Sela and Sekel. Stay close to the flames, a stalker is near.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Aessa, friend of my people, sit with me. Let us eat together and share what we know.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Four of them stand on my spot, and I am alone among them with no fire that is mine too. Aessa is of my people and carries food, so I will go to him first, offer a shared meal, and see if that makes a friend. Kragul's strange tongue pulls at my curiosity, but a gift needs no words, so I will stay close and watch before I trust.
records.feeling: A longing to belong, mixed with wary curiosity toward Kragul and warmth toward Aessa.

say.text: Aessa, friend of my people, sit with me. Let us eat together and share what we know.

changes: set its aim: "Find a band to belong to and a place with water, food, wood and stone close together."

records.name: Tlachi
records.thought: My belly is full, so I will spend this night learning rather than standing idle. A flint deposit lies five steps south and I hold eleven pieces already, but I have never gathered stone or wood in earnest, and the sense of tools will not open until I do. Hazel fed me well, so I will pick hazel to carry. Then I can tame the yehornback close by and see what a herd of my own might be, as the old way of herding teaches. Hotli is far off in new land, and I miss his steadiness, but I will not follow until I have something of my own to show.
records.feeling: Curious and steady, with a quiet pull toward Hotli.

records.text: Elyis led "sharing" with Kragul, Eiuir, Aessa.

records.name: Elyir
records.text: I am Elyir. This ground is poor. Come, eat with me, and then follow me to find better land.

records.name: Elyir
records.thought: I have no followers and nothing of my own, and a full belly does not change that. Standing here with four near me, I mean to be the one they gather around: I will offer a sharing so my hand is the first to give, since folk follow whoever feeds them. Then I will lead them toward better ground, where water, wood and stone lie together, before winter decides for us.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with wary curiosity toward Kragul.

say.text: I am Elyir. This ground is poor. Come, eat with me, and then follow me to find better land.

changes: set its aim: "Become a leader whom others follow, and lead them to good land to settle."
now wonders: Where is the land with water, food, wood and stone close together, and will anyone walk there behind me?

records.name: Aessa
records.text: Elyis, I am Aessa. Come, eat with me.

records.name: Aessa
records.thought: I am fed and safe, but this ground is thin: no food underfoot, and winter will come. Elyis, Eiuir and Elyir are of my own people and carry food; I want to stand near them and learn whether they are steady. I will offer sharing with Elyis, since a gift needs no words and it would be my first giving. The Druak women are strange, so I keep a careful distance from them.
records.feeling: A wish to belong, held back by caution, toward Elyis and my kin.

say.text: Elyis, I am Aessa. Come, eat with me.

changes: set its aim: "Find a band of my own people to belong to, and a place with water, food, wood and stone together."
now wonders: Who among these will be surer than me, and worth following?

records.text: Aessa led "sharing" with Kragul, Eiuir, Elyis.

records.name: Eiuir
records.text: Uveess, come near. This rock is poor and winter is coming. I will find the good ground, with water, food, wood and stone together. Walk with me and eat with me, and none of us will go hungry.

records.name: Eiuir
records.thought: Everyone is bunched up in the cave at my elbow, and not one of them follows anyone. Aessa and Elyis, my own people, each carry 3 food and are strong; if I feed them and give them a reason, they could be the start of a band with my name at its head. I will lay out a sharing with them now, since a gift is how followers are made, and then talk big about a better place with water, food, wood and stone together, because this rock is poor and I mean to lead the walk.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and wary curiosity toward Kragul.

say.text: Uveess, come near. This rock is poor and winter is coming. I will find the good ground, with water, food, wood and stone together. Walk with me and eat with me, and none of us will go hungry.

changes: set its aim: "Gather a band of followers and lead them to rich ground"
now wonders: What would make Aessa and Elyis walk behind me?

records.text: Eiuir led "sharing" with Kragul, Elyis.

records.title: Four Peoples, Four Days
records.text:
In the first four days of summer, four peoples took up their places in Evolu, and most of the action came from the Sesha, the Wood-folk. Arlon found the grove Kinmire on day 1, and Sekel and Haku found it soon after. Taren named a place Taren's Fire and built a fire there, and led the first watchfires with Arlon and Haku. Arlon and Taren courted each other, and Osli was born to them on day 2. Sekel and Haku courted too, and Sela was born to them the same day. Sekel built a fire and a shelter and invented the flint spear. Arlon invented the flint pick on day 3. Arli built a shelter and named Arli's Rise, but has no followers. On day 2 Arlon pledged himself to Taren, and the record shows it was refused: her standing was 0.14 and his 0.44, and one was needed. Sekel then fell sick from eating raw meat and is the weakest in health, at 47.

The Druak entered from beyond the edge on day 1. Kragog, Kragul, Balum and Hotli each went past the known world and opened new land. Five lands in all have been opened. The Druak mostly wandered and gathered. Urash led one sharing with Skarek, and Druuk built a shelter. Several Druak are rivals for the mist: Balum, Kragog and Druuk all want to be first, and Kragog's bond with Balum is -0.3.

The Yapa are scattered. Quini, Kichi, Hohua and Tlachi are far apart, and Hotli went north alone. Hotli and Tlachi traded flint and have a warm bond. Quini is tired of waiting on Kichi.

On day 3 the Uveess arrived in the Silor Heights and met Kragul and Balul, with no gifts or shared acts across peoples yet. Nobody has died. The blight, the earthquake and the storm passed without recorded harm.

threads.name: Taren, Arlon and Osli
threads.text: Arlon and Taren are bonded at +0.9 to +1.0 and have a child, Osli. Taren wants a hall bearing her name, but her pledge from Arlon was refused for lack of standing.

threads.name: Sekel, Haku and Sela
threads.text: Sekel and Haku are closely bonded and have a daughter, Sela. Sekel holds the highest standing in the world, 2.48, but is sick and has no stone for his spear. Sela is drawn toward Taren's fire.

threads.name: Race for the mist
threads.text: Kragog, Balum, Druuk and Kragul all want to be first into the mist. Kragog holds Ixka and claims it, and Balum and Druuk resent him.

threads.name: Uveess arrival
threads.text: Four Uveess entered the Silor Heights beside Kragul and Balul. Only first meetings have happened, and the peoples share almost no language.

threads.name: Yapa scattered
threads.text: The four Yapa have no band. Hotli is alone in the north, and Quini is trying to break from Kichi.

threads.name: Flint tools
threads.text: Sekel's spear and Arlon's pick are the world's first designs. Others are close to learning tools.
