voices.name: Arlon
voices.text: I am Arlon of the Sesha. I found a strange grove here that eased my loneliness. Come, there is food enough for all, and a place at the fire for each of you.

voices.name: Taren
voices.text: I am Taren of the Sesha. I will raise a fire and a roof here. No fire is left untended, and there is a place at mine for any who come.

voices.name: Haku
voices.text: Sekel, I'm Haku of the Sesha. I'm going to the flint too. Let's go together, two are safer than one in these woods.

voices.name: Arli
voices.text: I am Arli of the Sesha. A ridgecat hunts to the southeast, so keep away from it and stay close together. No fire goes untended and no one is refused a place at it. Come north with me, and I will build a hall where we can

voices.name: Sekel
voices.text: I am Sekel of the Sesha. I have flint, hard stone that takes an edge. Take one. Whoever stands with me will not go without tools.

voices.name: Taren
voices.text: Taren's Fire burns high tonight. Arlon, Arli, come sit; there is warmth and a place for each of you here.

voices.name: Urash
voices.text: Druak! I am Urash. Beasts hunt north and west. Come, let us keep together and stay safe.

voices.name: Hotli
voices.text: I am Hotli of the Yapa. There is flint enough for two. I will not take yours if you do not take mine.

voices.name: Kichi
voices.text: Hohua, Quini! I am Kichi. The grass here is rich and there is game close by. Stand with me and we hunt together, and nobody goes hungry. I will lead us to the best of it.

voices.name: Quini
voices.text: I am Quini of the Yapa. I come in peace. Kichi, I will walk to you and hear your plan. Know this: redcap hurts, but mudroot feeds.

voices.name: Haku
voices.text: Sekel, your flint was a true gift. I'll gather wood and stone beside you. If you'll have me, let's raise a fire together.

voices.name: Hotli
voices.text: Tlachi, take this flint. It is a gift from me, Hotli. A man who gives first and keeps his word is worth standing beside.

voices.name: Arli
voices.text: I am raising a shelter here, north of the fire, the first wall of a hall. Bring wood and stone, and there is a place under it for any Sesha.

voices.name: Balum
voices.text: Urash, I am Balum. I go to the edge of the world to venture into the mist. Come with me if you have courage, and we will both be sung of.

voices.name: Kichi
voices.text: Quini, well met! Mudroot feeds, you say, and I believe you. Come, take meat from my hands. A man who walks with Kichi eats well. Stay by me and I will lead us away from the dunecat to richer grass.

voices.name: Sekel
voices.text: Haku, yes. We raise a fire here, by the flint. Bring wood and stone. What we build will be called after us.

voices.name: Tlachi
voices.text: Hotli, I take your gift and I will repay it. Take some of my flint, and let us both learn what it can become.

voices.name: Taren
voices.text: Ridgecat close by the southeast, near my fire. Stay west and together. Taren's Fire has room and wood for any who come.

voices.name: Urash
voices.text: Balum, I am Urash. I will come with you to the edge. A stalker is west of us, so let us go together and stay close.

voices.name: Balum
voices.text: Urash, come to the edge with me. I go in first, and you will stand beside me when the mist opens.

voices.name: Sekel
voices.text: Haku, the ridgecat is southeast. Come north with me to the flint and stone, then we raise a hall here. Whoever carries wood and stone to it will have a place in it.

voices.name: Haku
voices.text: Sekel, the rain is heavy and the ridgecat is near. Come sit by my fire; I have wood to feed it high for us both.

voices.name: Taren
voices.text: Arlon, stay by Taren's Fire a while. The ridgecat prowls south, and two together are safer than one. I mean to raise a roof here, and I would have you under it.

voices.name: Hrokek
voices.text: Druuk, take this. Eat. I am Hrokek, and I will not let you fall.

voices.name: Arlon
voices.text: Taren, your fire gave me warmth and kept its word. I would stand beside you, and I would have a child with you if you are willing. I am Arlon, and I choose your fire.

voices.name: Tlachi
voices.text: Hotli, I come to pay what I owe. Take this flint from me. Kichi is sick, so keep clear of him as I will.

voices.name: Quini
voices.text: Kichi, I saw sunleaf ease you. I am bringing more for your sickness. Stay and rest.

voices.name: Sekel
voices.text: Haku, a stalker walks to the northeast. Stay close to me. I raise a roof here, and you will sleep under it.

voices.name: Taren
voices.text: Arlon, I am willing. Stand with me at Taren's Fire, and then we raise a hall that bears my name.

voices.name: Hotli
voices.text: Tlachi, you pay what you owe, and I will remember it. I mean to raise a hall and gather a band. Stand with me and you will not be a stranger there.

voices.name: Urash
voices.text: Balum, I am near. I keep my word to come with you. Let us gather the others first, there is food and water here, and four of us are safer than two at the mist.

voices.name: Haku
voices.text: Sekel, I'm coming to your roof. I'll gather two more wood on the way, then stand beside you.

voices.name: Balum
voices.text: Urash, the true edge lies southwest, farther than I thought. Walk behind me there, and when the mist opens, men will sing of us both.

voices.name: Arlon
voices.text: Taren, Osli is ours and I am glad. I will bring wood and stone, and we will raise your hall together at your fire.

voices.name: Tlachi
voices.text: Hotli, my debt is paid. I will watch what you build before I stand with you. I keep my word, and I will tell you what I learn of the foods here.

voices.name: Kragul
voices.text: A stalker is four steps north of the cave. Keep away from it and stay together. I go southwest toward the edge, come with me if you will.

voices.name: Taren
voices.text: Arlon, a ridgecat is close. Come with me to the fires at once, and then we gather wood for a roof that bears my name.

voices.name: Arli
voices.text: Arli of the Sesha opened the mist at the western edge. New woods lie beyond it with elk that have never seen us, and flint and peat in the ground. Come west, and there is a place for every Sesha at my hall.

voices.name: Osli
voices.text: Taren, I am staying beside you and Arlon by the fire while the ridgecat is near. When it is gone, will you walk with me to Kinmire?

voices.name: Taren
voices.text: Sesha, come to Taren's Fire. The ridgecat prowls south, but there is warmth and a place here for all who stand with me.

voices.name: Haku
voices.text: Sekel, I'm beside you now. Two more gatherings and I learn tools; then I raise the roof with you, wood in hand.

voices.name: Arlon
voices.text: Taren, I will gather flint and wood for your hall and come straight back. Keep Osli by the fire while the cat prowls. Sekel's new spear may keep it off us.

voices.name: Sekel
voices.text: Haku, I accept your courting. Stay under my roof; we make a child here, and the hall will be ours.

voices.name: Kichi
voices.text: Quini, well met, and thank you for the sunleaf. Keep a few steps from me, my sickness spreads and I will not see you fall to it. When I am clean I will share the best grass and the hunt with you, and you will walk with K

voices.name: Haku
voices.text: Sekel, our child is born and I am glad. I'm giving you wood for the roof and the fire; the cat is close, so let us all stay near the flames.

voices.name: Sekel
voices.text: Haku, stay with me. I eat, then we hunt the boar together, and the meat is yours as much as mine.

voices.name: Arlon
voices.text: Taren, I go to the flint for stone and will be back by your fire soon. Keep Osli close, and call out if the cat comes near.

voices.name: Kragul
voices.text: Balum, you found land past the edge. I go to the edge now to venture. Come with me and we try together?

voices.name: Taren
voices.text: Sela, come with me to Taren's Fire. The storm is cold, I have wood, and there is a place at my fire for you.

voices.name: Balum
voices.text: Kragul, yes. Walk with me to the edge. I found land past it once, and I will open the mist again.

voices.name: Urash
voices.text: Skarek, I am Urash. There is grain, berries and highbloom here by the water. Come and share food with me, and tell me who among us you think stands steady.

voices.name: Sela
voices.text: Taren, I am coming to your fire. A stalker is close in the northeast, so keep watch.

voices.name: Hrokek
voices.text: Druuk, your shelter is good. I am Hrokek. Let me stay near you through this storm and share what I find.

voices.name: Taren
voices.text: Sela, the stalker is close. Come to Taren's Fire now, stay near me, and we will feed the flames together.

voices.name: Skarek
voices.text: Skarek hears you. I trust what I see proven. I come to the grain and berries; show me the highbloom.

voices.name: Arli
voices.text: Osli, come in out of the storm. There is a roof here and food to share, and a place for you.

voices.name: Haku
voices.text: Arli, thank you for the roof. I'm going to Taren's Fire to find my child Sela and Sekel. Stay close to the flames, a stalker is near.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Aessa, friend of my people, sit with me. Let us eat together and share what we know.

voices.name: Elyir
voices.text: I am Elyir. This ground is poor. Come, eat with me, and then follow me to find better land.

voices.name: Aessa
voices.text: Elyis, I am Aessa. Come, eat with me.

voices.name: Eiuir
voices.text: Uveess, come near. This rock is poor and winter is coming. I will find the good ground, with water, food, wood and stone together. Walk with me and eat with me, and none of us will go hungry.
